'''Scan gates''' were security stations used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the [[Gwori shipyards]].

To prevent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] infiltration, scan gates were equipped with [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] beams to kill organics, as the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]] was almost entirely consisted of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Despite this, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] developed a countermeasure to infiltrate the shipyards. The strike team, save [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], was frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] controlled a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] to slip past the defenses. While in carbonite, the [[Scanner|life-form scanners]] couldn't pick up anything, and the radiation beam was useless. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] almost gave away the plan when he spoke via the droid in binary, but the droids didn't realize it. A [[Rat/Legends|rat]] nearly gave it away again, but the radiation beam destroyed it, and the Republic vessel ''[[VX-391]]'' managed to get past the gate. Later, when the remnants of the strike team attempted to flee, they stole a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigate]], but the ship was unarmed and unshielded, as the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] of [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] destroyed the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] during their [[Battle of Gwori|attack]]. The scan gate detected everyone, and [[Juhm]], not willing to let the Jedi escape, ordered the radiation beam activated. Despite this, the timely intervention of [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] destroyed the scan gate.
